metadata.notes: App goes live after primary. The 'general_election_candidate' field is null until the primary resolves. For uncontested primaries (single Democratic candidate), that candidate is the de facto general election candidate. For nonpartisan races, 'ldp_endorsed' marks Louisville Democratic Party endorsements.
